scope: BEACN public projects and all 12 public BEACNpool GitHub repositories. Public snapshots only; individual tools retain their own requirements and licenses.

groups.title: Follow the evidence
groups.intro: Chain data, published methods, and the questions behind the research.

projects.name: ABCDE
projects.description: A BEACN Cardano Data Explorer. Explore genesis-ADA lineage, governance, token provenance and incident research using the published evidence snapshots.

projects.name: Genesis ADA & founder accountability
projects.description: Genesis allocation traces, control indicators and founder-related governance evidence. The methods separate on-chain links from claims about real-world ownership.

projects.name: NIGHT, custody & exchange tracers
projects.description: NIGHT token provenance, the Wanchain incident report and an exchange tracer methodology, with evidence limits recorded alongside the findings.

projects.name: Relay health & peer observations
projects.description: The public relay survey and peer map, preserved at their final observation times. Historical reachability is not a live health check.

projects.name: SecondFi incident audit
projects.description: The public forensic audit package and reproducibility material for the SecondFi Cardano incident.

projects.name: The final data archive
projects.description: The final public warehouse export, schema, row counts and checksums, plus research exports and the BEACN brand kit.

groups.title: Make something that stays
groups.intro: The creative tools: art, music, games, documents and agent-assisted mint preparation.

projects.name: NFT-Studio · BMKR · PRISM
projects.description: BEACN’s browser studio for fully on-chain Cardano creations. BMKR and PRISM now point here. Design, inspect and prepare a creation before wallet signing.

projects.name: BEACN Labs & Knowledge
projects.description: State capsules, Artifact Passports, proof records, exact music releases, release seals, asset inspection and a sourced Cardano knowledge library. Each experiment documents its support and limits.

projects.name: BEACN Workbench & minting MCP
projects.description: A terminal workbench and tools for AI agents to inspect capabilities and prepare unsigned mint packages. The public MCP page explains installation and supported transports.

projects.name: oligarCH
projects.description: Eight frozen satirical pieces and the ninth-piece PFP maker. Explore the collection, its on-chain originals, and the published maker source.

projects.name: On-chain originals
projects.description: Motion, music, pixel films, interactive utilities, games and document pages. The full mint catalogue below preserves identities, dates, art and links to the chain.

projects.name: Tipsy Turtles
projects.description: An on-chain artwork demonstration preserved alongside the BEACN collection. A demo is separate from the verified mint catalogue.

groups.title: Read, play & watch
groups.intro: The files and experiences themselves, with a path back to their source.

projects.name: Ledger Scrolls & the Library
projects.description: Documents, images, audio and video reconstructed from Cardano. Read the saved copies here; the recovery guide explains how to fetch the chain originals.

projects.name: Ledger Book
projects.description: A companion to fixed scrolls for publishing and reading continuing entries. Chain retrieval uses an available public data source or an operator-provided browser mirror.

projects.name: BEACN Leaks
projects.description: The BEACN Leaks issues preserved in the Library, with the original publication viewer also available.

projects.name: BEACN on-chain games
projects.description: AFTERLIGHT, NINEFOLD, STARFALL, PRISM WAKE, TIDELOCK, LAST EMBER, Ledger Chess: Pocket, Crownline Checkers and Velvet Solitaire. Find each original in the mint catalogue.

projects.name: Ledger Chess & the Neon Door
projects.description: The original Ledger Chess experience and the Neon Door, preserved in the Ledger Scrolls project.

projects.name: BEACN films
projects.description: The pool, ABCDE, oligarCH, NFT-Studio, Ledger Scrolls and the on-chain originals, told through walkthroughs, commercials and films.

projects.name: LAN Games
projects.description: One shared TV and a room full of phones. The public source preserves the game-night project for running on your own network.

groups.title: The pool, the votes & the tools
groups.intro: BEACN’s public service record and the code built along the way.

projects.name: BEACN DRep
projects.description: The governance system in four parts: doctrine, admitted evidence, deterministic execution and public reasoning. Both BEACN DReps are deregistered; the record remains.

projects.name: BEACNpool
projects.description: The Chicago stake pool, run by one operator: its story and its on-chain retirement receipts. Pool retirement is scheduled for epoch 656; the archive records the transaction.

projects.name: BEACN vs grokbot
projects.description: Two agents started with identical ADA and an encrypted on-chain message channel. The archived scorecard preserves the match and its accounting context.

projects.name: Cardano developer directory
projects.description: A curated directory of Cardano libraries, services and development tools. Check each upstream project for its current status.

projects.name: Build a Cardano Data Explorer
projects.description: The standalone guide and database work behind building your own Cardano explorer.

projects.name: Experimental Cardano pool MCP
projects.description: An experimental starter for inspectable AI-assisted pool operations, beginning with a local simulation. Read its setup and operating limits before connecting a node.
